chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Jamil, from al-Hasan ibn Shihab, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about the skins of foxes, when they have been properly slaughtered: may one perform salat (prayer) in them? He said: Yes.

key_terms.الثَّعَالِبِ: foxes; the animal whose skins are being asked about
key_terms.جُلُودِ: skins or hides used as garments or material
key_terms.ذَكِيَّةً: properly slaughtered according to the prescribed legal method
key_terms.فِيهَا: in them, meaning while wearing or using those skins

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) in fox skins if they are properly slaughtered?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام regarding performing salat (prayer) in fox skins when they are properly slaughtered. It indicates permissibility in this specific case and is relevant to discussions of prayer clothing and ritual law.
